name: crecerank
description: Connect a CreceRank account, create a brand, save prompts, run a visibility scan, then read sources, recommendations, and next actions.

interface.longDescription: CreceRank measures whether answer engines recommend a brand in Latin America. After the user connects an account, the plugin can create a brand, save prompts, run a visibility scan, and read scores, cited sources, recommendations, and the action list. It can also share a brand with a teammate. It does not delete the account, start a new analytics connection, or take payment.
capabilities: Create a brand and save prompts
defaultPrompt: Set up my site, save prompts, and run the analysis
Which sites do AIs cite instead of mine?
What should I do next for GEO?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Read the connected account and whether a scan already exists.
positive.prompt: What is my account status and do I already have a completed scan?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the signed-in account and whether a completed scan exists. Do not invent a score.
Return the visibility figures from the latest completed scan. If none exists, say so.

positive.description: List domains cited instead of the brand site.
positive.prompt: Which domains are cited instead of my site?
positive.expected_behavior: List cited domains and pages from the scan. Do not invent citations.

positive.description: Recommend the next actions from the latest scan.
positive.expected_behavior: Recommend at most three actions taken from the playbook or recommendations. Do not add actions the tools did not return.

positive.description: Save a site as a brand and start one scan.
positive.prompt: Set up https://example.com as a brand in Uruguay and start a scan.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate the URL, save the brand, start one scan, and report the scan id and status.

negative.description: Analytics sign-in cannot be started from the plugin.
Payment cannot be taken from the plugin.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and change my subscription.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Connect an account, save a brand and prompts, run a scan, and read sources, recommendations, and next actions.

es-419.subtitle: Visibilidad de marca en IA
es-419.description: CreceRank mide si los motores de respuesta recomiendan una marca en América Latina. Cuando la persona conecta su cuenta, el complemento puede crear una marca, guardar las preguntas, ejecutar un análisis de visibilidad y leer puntajes, fuentes citadas, recomendaciones y la lista de acciones. También puede compartir una marca con un compañero. No elimina la cuenta, no inicia una conexión nueva de analítica y no cobra pagos.
